whenToUse: The price has really dropped below the recent selling price.
Discounts stack, as with coupons, and change the final rate.
People need to spot discounted items quickly in a list.
whenNotToUse: You'd base it on a list price the product never sold at (see anchoring).
The amount saved matters more (use a strikethrough price).
Every product is always on sale.
